issues.description: Method name mismatch: the problem statement (problem_statement.md) instructs students to implement a method named `printFarmSong()` in Farm.java (line 113), but both the template implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) and the reference solution (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) declare and use a method named `singFarmSong()` (template signature at line 9, solution signature at line 59). This inconsistency between the textual instructions and the codebase can confuse students about which method to implement or test against.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across all artifacts. Either update the problem statement and UML to refer to `singFarmSong()` (and mention `singFarmSongVerse()` if relevant), or rename the methods in the template and solution from `singFarmSong()` to `printFarmSong()` and update all references (including Main and any tests/documentation) so instructions and code use the same identifier.
